sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The present writ petition has been filed for following reliefs:-
"For direction upon the respondents (Respondent No.4 in particularly) to pay the compensation amount on the acquired landed property of the petitioner pertaining to Mouza-Bukru, Khata No.30, Plot No.434 and on the said land a Stabestus Roof of Building a is standing at the rate of 510/- Per A Sq. feet as paid in the L.A. caseNo.11 of 2013-14 and case of the petitioner is similar.
ii) For direction upon the respondents concerned to re-determine the compensation amount as two different rate has been fixed on the same purpose by the authority concerned."
2025:JHHC:36610 3.
Parity has been sought with the gotia.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is not clear that in both the law even in the Land Acquisition Act as well as in the Railway Act there is a provision for enhancement.
4. In that view of the matter, the present writ petition is hereby disposed of giving liberty to the litigant to approach the appropriate authority by invoking appropriate law.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Dated: 06th December, 2025 Amar/-
